breakdown.description: The two concentrated loads are replaced by a distributed couple over a boundary segment
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt gave contradictory instructions, first specifying two point loads using PointSource, and then stating to represent them as a distributed couple. The ground truth resolves this by explicitly stating to use PointSource terms. The generated specification correctly follows the ground truth by defining the loads as two distinct point loads represented by PointSource terms and completely omitting the incorrect instruction about the distributed couple.
